dimensions.assessment: Affects telecommunications and cable entities holding FCC licenses or authorizations with connections to specified foreign countries, as well as the FCC.
dimensions.evidence: publish on the internet website of the Commission a list of each entity... with respect to which a covered entity holds an equity or voting interest

dimensions.assessment: Requires information collection, rulemaking, and public disclosure of foreign-owned entities holding FCC licenses.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 18 months after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Commission shall issue rules to obtain information

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative costs for FCC rulemakings and list publication, but no specific spending amounts or appropriations are provided.
Directs the FCC to conduct a rulemaking, collect ownership data, and establish a public reporting mechanism.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 18 months after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Commission shall issue rules to obtain information

dimensions.assessment: Requires ongoing, annual updates to the published list of entities.
dimensions.evidence: The Commission shall, not less frequently than annually, update the list published under subsection (a)

missing_information: The exact number of affected licensees and the administrative cost to the FCC are not provided.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs the FCC to publish and annually update an internet list of FCC license and authorization holders with ownership ties to specified foreign adversaries (China, Iran, North Korea, Russia).
